name: File upload
summary: Drop zone with a real file input, with the files below it. Each file shows its progress and status, and has slots for a preview, your own actions and free content.
use: Add documents or images to a form or project.
avoid: One small file in a compact form: a normal button with a file input is enough.
anatomy: Drop zone: featured icon, action link, drag text, hint.
Files: a list of File upload items below the drop zone.
File upload item: file icon or your own media, name, size, progress or a spinner with text, and on the right your own actions, the done icon and the remove button.
Optional content below a file, inside its card.
figmaProps: Native slot below the drop zone with File upload items in it. Off by default. Add, remove or reorder the items in the slot.
Processing: a spinner with a text instead of the progress bar. Change the text with Processing text.
_File upload item: Media / Show media, Show icon
Native slot for a preview. Turn Show icon off when you use it.
Native slot on the right for your own buttons.
Native slot below the file for free content.
reactProps: Slot for the files: FileUploadItem elements. They become a named list below the drop zone.
FileUploadItem name / size / progress / error / onRemove
onRemove also works when the file is complete.
processing: the upload is done and the file is being checked or converted.
Slot that replaces the icon, for example a thumbnail.
Slot on the right for your own buttons: "Try again", "Replace".
Slot for free content below the file, inside the card: the result of a check, an Alert. Pass null while it is empty.
files is the name of the list.
{ failed, uploading(name), uploaded, remove(name), processing, processingFile(name) }
behaviour: Clicking opens the file picker. Dragging shows the Drag over state.
Each file gets its own item with progress.
The drop zone passes every file on. Checking the type and the size is up to your page: show the reason in an item with status error.

Pattern "artwork check" (see Examples): upload, check, a result with a list of checks, a warning with actions, a wrong file type and a check that timed out. The checks and their rules live in your page.
a11y: Works fully without dragging: the action link opens the native file input.
File upload item reads out only the result ("report.pdf uploaded", or that the upload failed) in a status region; the progress bar is not read out at every step.
The remove button has a label with the file name.
With children the files are a list with a name, so a screen reader says how many files there are.
Processing is read out once ("Checking report.pdf").
content: The hint names the file types and maximum size: "PDF, JPG or PNG (max. 10 MB)".
The error message names the cause: "The file is larger than 10 MB."
do: Check the type and size before uploading.
Give an error its own action in the actions slot, for example "Try again".
Say it when a result is an estimate.
dont: A warning without a next step.
open: In State Complete the progress bar stays at 100%. With content below the file that is a lot in one card.
Not built: a component for the list of checks. The pattern uses a description list with a Badge per row.
